files.description: Bike-share stations (48 rows, one per station): station_code (four-digit code with leading zeros, e.g. "0040"), station_name (text, a few with accented letters), district (same 6 districts as riders.csv; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), docks (whole number), opened_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD).

task_text: Write a per-district station report from stations.csv, using district trimmed and written with each word capitalised (e.g. Old Town). `result` should be a table indexed by district in alphabetical order with columns stations (count), total_docks, mean_docks (1 decimal), first_opened and last_opened (earliest and latest opened_on, as YYYY-MM-DD text).
intended_computation: Read stations.csv; clean district (strip spaces, each word capitalised, e.g. Old Town); per district: stations = count, total_docks = sum of docks, mean_docks (1 decimal), first_opened and last_opened = earliest and latest opened_on as YYYY-MM-DD text. Index district, alphabetical.

acceptable_variants.notes: district labels may differ in letter case; district may be a column
